reference.prompt:
Style/medium: 2D mobile idle RPG game art; clean cartoon style with bold dark outlines, flat cel shading with one shadow tone and one highlight tone; slightly chunky proportions (head about one third of body height for humanoids); silhouette readable at small size
Color palette: saturated but not neon; 3-5 main colors per subject
Lighting/mood: soft light from the top left; cheerful fantasy
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos or trademarks, no watermark, no signature

Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: 2D game hero reference sprite
Input images: Image 1 is the exact desired drawing style and simplification level. Study only this character's visual design.
Primary request: redraw this little swordsman as a young brave knight with short BROWN hair, a BLUE tunic over minimal light gray steel armor, a RED scarf and a short sword in the right hand. Turn him to face RIGHT in a side-view idle stance for a side-scrolling game.
Style priority: faithfully match Image 1. Extremely simple, squat, cute chibi doodle with a large rounded head and tiny chunky body, very short stubby legs, mitten hands, tiny solid black oval eye, almost no facial features. The head including hair is roughly half the standing height, as in Image 1. Thick near-black slightly irregular outlines, simple compact shapes and very few interior lines. Each material is a flat color with at most one small hard-edged shadow patch. Minimal light gray armor is only a plain small shoulder shape; the blue shirt is the dominant torso shape.
Composition: single whole character centered, sword and scarf fully visible, boots on one baseline. Transparent background.
Avoid: glossy armor, shiny metal reflections, realistic anatomy, modeled volume, gradients, rim lighting, soft shading, texture, thin lines, detailed hair strands, elaborate equipment, knee plates, belts with buckles, rivets, segmented gauntlets, white sticker border, shadow under feet. No text or extra objects. Match the reference's simplicity, not a polished 3D mobile game render.

notes: 원본 PNG와 생성 알파를 보존했습니다. 알파 16을 기준으로 실루엣을 찾아 분리하고 외곽의 원래 알파도 포함했습니다.
생성기가 출력한 서로 다른 해상도는 각 시트의 셀 너비를 1024로 환산하여 통일했습니다. 이후 모든 클립과 프레임에 하나의 공통 배율을 적용했습니다.
대기 첫 프레임의 머리부터 발끝까지 높이는 150픽셀입니다. 몸 중심은 x=128, 서 있는 프레임의 발끝은 y=192입니다.
사망 프레임은 넘어진 몸이 같은 바닥 줄에 닿도록 정렬했습니다.
RGBA는 premultiplied-alpha LANCZOS로 축소했습니다. 캐릭터 내부의 색과 알파를 다시 칠하지 않았습니다.
시안과 달랐던 초기 기준·대기, 검이 셀 범위를 벗어났던 공격 원본은 rejected/에 보존했습니다.
